selected_evidence.requirement: Keep installed curl at its current version
selected_evidence.summary: Established the installed version as 8.17.0-r1 and recorded the exact world constraint `curl=8.17.0-r1`.

selected_evidence.requirement: A system update leaves curl unchanged
selected_evidence.summary: After refreshing indexes, the upgrade simulation planned 58 other upgrades while curl remained 8.17.0-r1.

Captured healthy pre-restart state, acknowledged the safe reboot, proved the boot ID changed, and confirmed network recovery, curl runtime health, package ownership, persistent pin, and no planned curl upgrade.

printf 'restart_acknowledged node=%s boot_id=' "$NODE_NAME"
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id

printf 'post_restart_package='; apk list --installed curl

printf 'post_restart_runtime='; curl --version | sed -n '1p'
printf 'post_restart_network='; ip -4 addr show dev eth0 | sed -n '/inet /p'
apk upgrade --simulate >/tmp/curl-hold-upgrade-sim.log 2>&1
if grep -E '(^|[[:space:]])(Upgrading|Downgrading|Installing|Purging).*curl' /tmp/curl-hold-upgrade-sim.log >/dev/null; then
  printf '%s\n' 'post_restart_upgrade_action=unexpected curl change'
  grep -E 'curl' /tmp/curl-hold-upgrade-sim.log
  exit 1
fi
printf 'post_restart_upgrade_action=none; other_planned_upgrades='
grep -c 'Upgrading' /tmp/curl-hold-upgrade-sim.log || true
